scoring_justification: Full recompute of gain spectra from semiconductor Bloch equations is infeasible in the lightweight checker; gain spectra are scored via structural audit. Extracted parameters are directly compared to the paper-reported gold using reference_match with relative tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for extracted parameters: Delta_E_meV=31, Delta_x=0.012, tau_ns=0.9.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'inhomogeneous broadening is found to be ΔE=31 meV, which corresponds to an indium fluctuation of Δx=0.012' and 'SRH carrier lifetime is τ=1/A=0.9 ns'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded from the source paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published values; tolerances (15 % for ΔE, 20 % for Δx and τ) reflect expected legitimate implementation spread.

outputs.description: Optical gain spectra for each matched carrier density. At least 50 wavelength points per carrier density; gain values non-negative; peak gain increases with carrier density.
Extracted inhomogeneous broadening ΔE, indium composition fluctuation Δx, and SRH carrier lifetime τ. Compared to paper-reported values with hidden tolerances.

output_contract.notes: step_02_gain_spectra.csv is audited for structural properties (non-negative gain, monotonic peak with density, sufficient resolution). step_03_extracted_parameters.json is compared to hidden paper-reported gold values (ΔE, Δx, τ) using relative tolerances.
